name: The Camden News
notes: Chronicling America (chroniclingamerica.loc.gov and loc.gov) blocked network access via Cloudflare challenge, could not query directly. NJ State Library digitized-newspapers guide for Camden County lists Camden Democrat, Camden Daily Courier, and Courier-Post, but no title 'Camden News' for 1915-1918. Camden County Historical Society holds physical issues (v.1, v.2) per Danky note but online archive (cdm17435.contentdm.oclc.org) is membership-gated with no direct hit confirmed. IA advanced search returned only unrelated results (Christie speeches, YouTube, podcasts).

WebSearch for 'Greater News Newark NJ Jeanne Jason' found no matching title in Newark Public Library or Rutgers digitized newspaper inventories.

name: Black Newark
notes: Strong lead: Rutgers Dana Library's 'Newark Black Newspapers Collection' (collections.libraries.rutgers.edu/newark-black-newspapers) holds digitized Black Newark v.1 no.1-3 (Apr-Nov 1968), confirmed by multiple sources. However the collection's search/viewer is a JS-driven Drupal front end proxying a separate rucore.libraries.rutgers.edu partner-portal search (easyXDM iframe), which returned empty responses to direct HTTP requests even with cookies/referer set -- could not retrieve an actual item URL or page image within the lean time budget. Also pulled a related NJS journal article ('Putting the Black Ink Back into Print,' njs.libraries.rutgers.edu/index.php/njs/article/view/266) but its PDF is pure scholarly text with no reproduced newspaper images, so it was discarded as not a primary source. Recommend a follow-up pass with a JS-capable browser tool against collections.libraries.rutgers.edu/newark-black-newspapers/results.

name: The Nubian News
whyMatch: The Nubian News's own site hosts a self-published PDF archive of full back issues under assets/pdf/. Downloaded Vol. 6 No. 1 (Jan. 7, 2022), a complete 12-page issue of the actual newspaper -- masthead, layout, articles, ads all present. Title, city (Trenton), and publisher (Kamau Kujichagulia, per site) match the dankyNote exactly; this is an active, still-publishing paper (yearCeased null).
